No arbitrary callback supplies a finished model, output, closure or score.

Full scientific cohort and work counts remain intact:423 source/29 evaluation sessions,126/13 animals,160 CV fits,6-12 full refits,168 candidate fits/author contexts and696 candidate session predictions.

Independent late actual-method review is a valid separate grading prerequisite provided the source seal and first-exposure boundary are enforced during production, failed/invalid methods stay reported, and no target is opened first. It is not mechanical proof of semantic compliance or authentic qualification.

Exact scientificV2 target conversion, domain-event membership, lag availability, literal-True qualification and structural constancy repairs are present. Their source-derived correctness does not replace independent tiny controls or authentic numerical parity.

Task-owned controller/source, observer receipt and provider/runtime resource qualifications remain unqualified. No actual environment, input custody, provider access, numerical reference competence or scientific performance is inferred from this review.

new_findings.finding: Independent admission joins embedded result/terminal descriptors but does not authenticate their embedded body values to actual RESULT.json and TERMINAL.json pins. Actual files are rehashed with retain=False. Modified embedded OOF/model/lineage data can therefore drive graph/selection checks while the unchanged actual body hashes still pass.
new_findings.required_change: Before any graph use, require canonical encoded embedded result and terminal identities to equal their closed actual pins (or same-open parsed-body equality), and require the result pin to belong to the unique RESULT.json member. Preserve exact bundle/artifact joins.

new_findings.finding: Finite but arbitrarily poor canonical float64 predictions can remain finite after float32 cast while native float32 metric reductions overflow. The diagnostic raises on nonfinite metric output and suppresses publication of otherwise valid canonical scores.
new_findings.required_change: Represent nonfinite native-convention reductions as explicit non-comparability/failure of that diagnostic, preserving full canonical outputs. Genuine dependency, physical-custody or unexpected operation failures remain distinct failed-operation evidence; do not convert them to a successful diagnostic. No native SOTA/parity claim is permitted.

new_findings.finding: The adopted undefined-endpoint contract retains SSE/MSE/MAE, support and reason. Current source returns SSE/SST/mean/R-squared but omits weighted MAE, explicit MSE and support/reason fields.
new_findings.required_change: Return same-weight SSE/MSE/MAE, complete session/window/timestamp counts and per-head undefined reasons, including exact constant targets. Since within-animal weights sum to one, normalized weighted SSE equals MSE. Primary R-squared and biological weighting remain unchanged.

new_findings.finding: Preparation generates random opaque aliases, then reference source/animal traversal sorts those aliases. Fresh preparation of identical originals changes training-window order and therefore the interpretation of the fixed PCG64 permutation and AdamW update order, contrary to the frozen original-source ordering.
new_findings.required_change: Carry source-owned stable session/animal ordinals or explicit order arrays from the authenticated original roster, and use them for source training, OOF/evaluation traversal and tie-relevant reductions. Keep opaque labels as identifiers, not sorting keys, and keep original private identifiers out of candidate mounts. Verify invariance to alias renaming.

new_findings.finding: Optional analysis and numeric-feature stages are admitted more weakly than final fit/infer. Analysis role/tool/mode can disagree with its panel; feature stage treatment, animal, full allowed views and recipe are not all joined to the exact following inference. Projection admission reconstructs from the supplied role/tool, so it does not fix the mismatch. Per-slot feature/prompt/provider typed-value ancestry is also not independently joined to that exact inference.
new_findings.required_change: Require exact panel/mode/role/tool/animal, full authorized training/evaluation sets and appropriate sealed recipe/state for every optional producer. Join actual feature result and frozen prompt to reconstructed provider request identity, exact panel/animal/ordinal completion and typed returned values, then to the following inference provider_values. No neural/T1/cross-animal information may enter C/T0 through an optional stage.

new_findings.finding: Journal retains the global Budget while Engine/Provider/Authors/Runtime emit panel-dependent records. Provider actions, generated source, mount lists and products thus debit global writes but bypass PanelBudget.write_bytes. The claimed complete matched panel I/O ceiling omits data-dependent investigative work.
new_findings.required_change: Charge panel-owned event encoding/publication through the same persistent panel ceiling and parent exactly once, including scope start/end and final panel event. A single-use prepaid final event must retain its debit and original before/after publication/fsync deadline checks even after a closed flag change; late/failed persistence cannot become successful completion. Explicit one-time shared preparation/reference/final aggregate work remains separate.
